title.zh: Coinbase向美国散户投资者提供IPO股票，Oura率先登场
title.en: Coinbase Brings IPO Shares to US Retail Traders, With Oura Up First

current_state.zh: Coinbase本周将通过其应用向符合资格的美国散户客户开放IPO份额认购，智能戒指制造商Oura将是首家；Oura计划在纳斯达克以代码OURA上市，发行5000万股，预期价格区间为每股40至44美元。Coinbase表示，订单不保证获配，可能全部获配、部分获配或被拒绝；若在30天内卖出IPO股票，可能被禁止参与随后60天的IPO。
current_state.en: Coinbase is opening IPO allocations to eligible U.S. retail customers through its app this week, with smart-ring maker Oura as the first company; Oura plans to list on Nasdaq under ticker OURA, offering 50 million shares at an expected $40 to $44 each. Coinbase said orders do not guarantee an allocation and may be filled in full, partially, or rejected, and selling IPO shares within the first 30 days may bar participation for the following 60 days.
